# Morpho Blue isolated markets and vaults — facts

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Blue isolates risk per market in three ways. Borrower collateral stays idle in the contract: `supplyCollateral` credits only the borrower's collateral balance and never the market's lendable supply. Bad debt lands only on the suppliers of the market where it occurred. Blue has no supply caps, so lenders and vault curators control exposure by choosing which markets to fund. The whitepaper argues that skipping re-hypothecation lets markets run at higher average utilization. (high confidence) — https://github.com/morpho-org/morpho-blue/blob/main/morpho-blue-whitepaper.pdf · keywords: Morpho Blue isolated markets and vaults · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/morpho-org/morpho-blue/main/src/Morpho.sol, https://docs.morpho.org/learn/concepts/blue/
- [statement] Morpho Vault V2 replaces the single supply cap per market with adapters, ids and caps. An adapter is a contract that moves assets into one protocol and reports its value through `realAssets()`. The curator can enable new adapters without a vault upgrade. The curator defines abstract `ids` for a risk factor, such as a collateral token, an oracle or a market configuration, and gives each id an absolute or relative cap. A docs example is 'Max 20% of the vault allocated to any market using a specific, new oracle'. The roles are owner, curator, allocator and sentinel. The sentinel can deallocate assets, cut caps and revoke pending actions. (high confidence) — https://docs.morpho.org/learn/concepts/vault-v2 · keywords: Morpho Blue isolated markets and vaults · also: https://vaultbook.gauntlet.xyz/vaults/morpho-vaults/v2-vaults, https://www.bankless.com/read/morpho-vaults-v2-defi

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Vault V2 can be permissioned with allowlists, unlike non-permissioned V1 vaults. Morpho warns that some gate implementations can stop certain users from depositing or withdrawing, which weakens the non-custodial guarantee. A Fee Wrapper inherits the limits of the vault it wraps, so the underlying vault's gates can block wrapper users even when the wrapper's own gates are abdicated. (medium confidence) — https://docs.morpho.org/learn/concepts/vault-v2 · keywords: Morpho Blue isolated markets and vaults · also: https://vaultbook.gauntlet.xyz/vaults/morpho-vaults/v2-vaults

## Facts and statements

- [statement] A Morpho Blue market pairs one loan token with one collateral token. Five parameters define it: loan token, collateral token, oracle address, interest rate model (IRM) address and liquidation LTV (LLTV). The contract stores each market under an id derived from those parameters and has no function that edits them afterwards, so each market is immutable and separate from every other market. (high confidence) — https://github.com/morpho-org/morpho-blue/blob/main/morpho-blue-whitepaper.pdf · keywords: Morpho Blue isolated markets and vaults · also: https://docs.morpho.org/learn/concepts/blue/, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/morpho-org/morpho-blue/main/src/Morpho.sol
- [statement] Vault bad-debt handling differs by version. In V1.0, realized market bad debt lowers the vault share price at once, so all depositors share the loss pro rata. In V1.1 the vault 'does not realize the bad debt': the share price does not fall, and 'the last vault users will face the bad debt unless action is taken'. Anyone, including the curator, can cover the loss by supplying loan tokens. (high confidence) — https://docs.morpho.org/curation/tutorials/bad-debt · keywords: Morpho Blue isolated markets and vaults · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/morpho-org/metamorpho-v1.1/main/README.md
- [statement] A vault counts as a Morpho Vault V2 only if two things hold. It sets its adapter registry to the Morpho Registry, which Morpho governance maintains and which lists Morpho Markets V1 and V2 and Morpho Vaults V1. Its curator also abdicates the ability to change that registry. Before abdication the curator can still change the registry. (high confidence) — https://docs.morpho.org/curate/concepts/adapter-registry/ · keywords: Morpho Blue isolated markets and vaults · also: https://docs.morpho.org/learn/concepts/vault/
